# Deel

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 26 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: SaaS marketing design: a white field with a 64px #1b1b1b promo strip and 80px sticky nav, a 732px #201547 purple hero panel with 4%-white glass action tiles and a 375x51 rounded-full CTA pill, #b1d8fc sky accent chips, #faf4ee cream details and hairlines, BagossCondensed 60-160px display over BagossStandardVF pills and an Inter UI, 459x928 pricing tier cards on elevation-2dp, and a MUI FAQ accordion.

Captured 2026-11-13, read-only (the marketing site is fully public; the product lives behind app.deel.com - an authenticated boundary never reached; Book a demo, Claim offer and Log in were measured as destinations, never followed). Themes: light.

A token set and component reference for Deel's public marketing surface — for building SaaS marketing pages, hero panels, pricing tiers and FAQ sections in the style of the real thing. It was read from **deel.com** on **2026-11-13**, signed out, in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900 and 390 x 844. Captured: the home page, /pricing/, /hr/, /global-payroll/ and /about-us/, plus a 390px mobile pass on home and pricing.

Deel is worth a capture because a Next.js + MUI + Tailwind marketing site paints an unusually confident system: a white field topped by a 64px `#1b1b1b` promo strip and an 80px nav, a 732px `#201547` deep-purple hero panel carrying five glass action tiles and a 375x51 rounded-full white Book-a-demo pill, `#b1d8fc` sky-blue accents on the promo chip and pricing-card top strip, and `#faf4ee` cream on footer headings and FAQ hairlines. Three voices carry the type: BagossCondensedFont at 60px/500 on the hero (160px/600 on the about numeral), BagossStandardVF at 14-15px/500 on nav items and small pills, and Inter at 400/600 on everything else. Interactive language is one pill: `#1b1b1b` fills with white text for primary, white fills with ink text for secondary, inverting to `#3f3f3f` on hover/pressed. **Boundary:** the product lives behind app.deel.com — an authenticated surface never reached; Book a demo, Claim offer and Log in were measured, never followed; the Cookiebot banner was hidden, never answered; no form was opened, typed into or submitted.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### Known gaps (from README.md)

- **Automation was masked during capture.** Until 2026-11-20, `tools/capture/public/lib.mjs` hid `navigator.webdriver` in every page it opened, so every committed reading was taken with that mask. The mask is removed (a bot check is now recorded as a boundary, not bypassed); whether any page needed it to load is not known, and a recapture without it is the check.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do spend the purple on the hero.** `#201547` is the home hero panel — a band, not the page; the marketing field stays white. See [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png).
2. **Do keep the ink for actions.** `#1b1b1b` paints the promo strip, the primary pills and the nav text — one near-black, not a ramp of greys. See [nav-demo](components/crops/nav-demo-default.png).
3. **Do glass the tiles on dark.** The hero action tiles are 4%-white fill with a 10%-white hairline on the purple panel — translucency, not a lighter paint. See [hero-tile](components/crops/hero-tile-default.png).
4. **Do round the controls.** 200px small pills, full-radius hero CTAs, a 50% hamburger circle; cards and tiles get 12px. See [hero-demo](components/crops/hero-demo-default.png).
5. **Do pair the Bagoss voices.** BagossCondensedFont owns every display heading (60px hero to 160px numeral); BagossStandardVF owns nav items and small pills; Inter carries body copy. See [hero-h1](components/crops/hero-h1-default.png).
6. **Don't style the app from this package.** app.deel.com is an authenticated product that was never reached — this package covers the marketing site only.
7. **Don't invent a dark theme.** The promo strip, purple hero and video cards are dark surfaces inside the single theme; there is no dark token set.
8. **Don't treat the promo strip as static.** Offers are served per region/campaign; what is captured is what this IP was served.
